details.cardSet: Combined Set "Banquet of Dreams & Trial of the Omens"
details.effect: Select a follower in your cemetery with both the Omen and Mage traits that costs 3 or less and summon it.

issues: Cemetery summon filter is too broad: `traitsAny` matches a follower with either Omen or Mage, but the source requires both traits. Change the filter to require both Omen and Mage traits, which needs an AND-style trait filter rather than `traitsAny`.
